name: Transformers
one_liner: Library for inference and training with pretrained models.
what_it_is: A library that, in its own words, provides what is needed for inference or training with pretrained models, aimed at developers, machine learning engineers and researchers. It gives many architectures one loading and calling interface, so swapping model is largely a change of identifier.
why_it_matters: It is how most published weights are actually loaded, which makes it the practical entry point to using someone else’s model rather than training your own. The uniform interface hides real differences between architectures, so a model that loads cleanly can still be the wrong shape for the task.
suitable_for: Loading and running published pretrained weights
Fine-tuning an existing model rather than training from scratch
not_suitable_for: High-throughput serving, where an inference engine handles batching and memory better
Very small deployments, where the dependency footprint outweighs the convenience
Architectures with no published implementation, which still need writing
